title: Welcome to Decap CMS
description: We have successfully migrated to Decap CMS.
author: John Doe
body:
# Welcome to Decap CMS

This is our first post using Decap CMS. The migration was a success!
We are now using a Git-based workflow for all our content.

title: Why We Migrated
description: A look into our decision to move away from Ghost CMS.
author: John Doe
body:
# Why We Migrated

We wanted more control over our content and a tighter integration with our Git workflow.
Decap CMS provides exactly what we need without the overhead of an external API dependency.
